2124980289873314031.en_summary: tenet_research reports $AMD filed an SEC registration covering the potential resale of up to 336.9M shares, including 320M tied to performance-based warrants issued to OpenAI and Meta ($META). OpenAI can acquire up to 160M AMD shares at $0.01 each subject to GPU purchase milestones and stock-price targets up to $600, expiring Oct 2030. Meta similar 160M shares expiring Feb 2031. Vesting tied to 6 GW GPU purchases. Also covers ~15M from World Labs and 1.96M from Taalas acquisitions. $NVDA and NVentures listed for 437,338 shares. This is resale registration, not announced sale; warrants subject to conditions. AMD receives no proceeds.
2124980289873314031.zh_summary: tenet_research 報導 $AMD 提交 SEC 註冊，涵蓋潛在轉售最多 336.9M 股，包括與向 OpenAI 和 Meta（$META）發行的績效認股權證相關的 320M 股。OpenAI 可按每股 $0.01 收購最多 160M 股 $AMD，視 GPU 購買里程碑及股價目標高達 $600 而定，2030 年 10 月到期。Meta 類似 160M 股，2031 年 2 月到期。歸屬條件與 6 GW GPU 購買相關。亦涵蓋 World Labs 收購約 15M 股及 Taalas 1.96M 股。$NVDA 及 NVentures 列有 437,338 股。此為轉售註冊，非宣布出售；認股權證受條件限制。AMD 不從股東轉售中獲收益。

ticker_notes.AMD: 註冊最多 336.9M 股潛在轉售，主要為未歸屬認股權證
